description.text: Introduction Industrial Economics involves the study of theoretical and applied microeconomics, with a particular focus on the modern business enterprise and its operating environment. The degree provides its graduates with the knowledge and skills base necessary to pursue a range of general business and management careers, as well as to undertake research in economics and related areas. Around a core of industrial economics and quantitative methods modules, students have a significant flexibility to assemble an individual suite of optional modules across a range of business disciplines, and to suit their own particular academic interests and career aspirations. Year one The first year of the course includes core modules in micro economics, entrepreneurship, the economics of decision making, organisational studies, business computing and quantitative methods. Year two Second-year studies include core modules in micro economics, the economics of innovation, the economics of pricing and decision making, the economics of organisation, international firms, quantitative methods and econometrics. Year three The final year includes core modules in industrial economics, the economics of regulation, corporate restructuring and economic policy making. Career You will have a firm foundation for a successful career in a range of business areas or for further study and research. You will have a detailed knowledge of economic concepts and the skills to independently apply them to economic and business issues.

duration.text: The Industrial Economics at Huazhong University of Science and Technology is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5277 USD/per year ￥ 38000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of postgraduate school 5. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 6. photocopy of awards certificate If applicable 7. Study plan Including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief.

requirements.text: 1. Have obtained Master's Degree 2. Be in good health 3. Be under the age of 45 4. Good command of English
